WITH media_rates AS (
  SELECT mt.Name AS media_type_name,
         1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS byte_rate,
         COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM MediaType AS mt
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.Name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM media_rates
), above_average AS (
  SELECT mr.byte_rate, mr.track_count, o.avg_rate
  FROM media_rates AS mr
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE mr.byte_rate > o.avg_rate
)
SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS average_byte_rate,
       AVG(track_count) AS average_track_count,
       AVG(byte_rate - avg_rate) AS average_excess_byte_rate
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: A media type means a distinct Name; types with the same name are combined. NULL Bytes are ignored by SUM, and a group with no non-NULL Bytes has a NULL rate, which is excluded from the average and above-average comparison.
